title: PANDA: pancreatic lesion detection on non-contrast CT with deep learning
summary: PANDA was trained on non-contrast abdominal CT scans from 3,208 patients at a high-volume pancreatic cancer centre in Shanghai. On a separate chest CT test set it reported 86.0% sensitivity and 98.9% specificity for lesion detection. The evidence is retrospective, and the press figure of 93% sensitivity on a larger set of over 20,000 scans is not confirmed against the primary paper.
ai_technology: PANDA (three-stage deep learning cascade on non-contrast CT)
organization: DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group; Shanghai Institute of Pancreatic Diseases; First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University
